requirements.description: User wants the property located near green spaces. Per the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), the threshold is rounded to 74.

The user wants energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Area (600 sqm), capacity (45 people), and proximity to green spaces are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area.

output.explanation: Filters ESTATES to school buildings ('Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600 sqm, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy class A1–D, and green score >= 74. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the given coordinates. The capacity of 45 people is not in the extracted requirements, so no predicate was added for it.
